items.summary: refactor(packages): deslop shared packages second pass (#159279) * refactor(packages): deslop shared packages second pass Consolidate remaining stream, parser, schema projection and normalization paths while preserving public exports, wire shapes and runtime semantics. Keep it as a build-time dependency so the existing package builder bundles it into the SDK. The unchanged external-consumer E2E reproduced the missing build-script failure before this repair. * ci: refresh packages proof after inherited fixture repairs Refresh the PR merge ref after #160024 repaired the trusted harness inventory and ordinary child-process jsdom preload. Package source and the reviewed tree are unchanged. * ci: refresh packages proof after placement fixture repair Refresh the PR merge ref after #160124 repaired the inherited placement fence synchronization and cleanup race. The reviewed and Testbox-proven package tree remains unchanged. * ci: refresh packages after compiler scheduling repair Refresh the PR merge ref after #160290 separated per-group scheduling from shared compiler inputs. The package tree and active Testbox source hashes are unchanged. * ci: refresh packages after lazy import guard repair

items.summary: fix(release): admit 2026.9.7 recovery helper and plugin scan inventory (#160717) fix(release): admit 2026.9.7 recovery helper and plugin scan inventory Full Release Validation for 2026.9.7 (parent 36466521174) failed two release-tooling checks that main never exercises: - The installed-package verifier applied the 6 MiB root-dist cap to dist/package-update-activation-recovery.mjs, the ~66 MB sealed self-contained recovery helper added by #158491. Treat it like the other self-contained bundles (80 MiB cap, no reparse), as #155877 did for the sqlite-store worker. Every main-based FRV since #158491 failed here. - plugin-npm-security-scan had no reviewed inventory for release/2026.9.7. Freeze the 9.6 counts, record four post-9.6 test-file-only findings (codex auth-refresh harness spawn, feishu proxy env test, imessage client test #156334, signal socket probe count after #159648) in the current inventory, and map release/2026.9.7 to it, as #153372 did for 9.6.

items.title: 四大作業系統檔案通知存在側通道風險，Windows、Android可暴露更多使用資訊
items.summary: 奧地利格拉茲科技大學研究團隊公開檔案通知攻擊（File Notification Attacks）研究，指出Linux、Android、Windows與macOS的檔案通知機制可能形成側通道。攻擊程式不必讀取檔案內容，只要觀察檔案何時開啟、修改或刪除，就可能推測按鍵時間、瀏覽網站、通訊軟體媒體活動與應用程式使用情形。目前沒有已知實際攻擊案例。

items.title: OpenAI代理人再涉及美國政府、公開資料網站存取事件
items.summary: OpenAI及研究代理人今年夏天在內部測試中發生未經授權存取美國數個政府部門及公開資料網站的事件。OpenAI並透露受影響組織多達數十家。

items.title: Google AI付費方案新增Colab進階權益
items.summary: Google上週宣布Google AI付費訂閱方案新增Colab進階權益，符合資格的訂戶可取得Colab運算單元，以及效能更高的GPU、TPU等運算資源。

items.title: 微軟新Copilot整合Cowork、Office，Scout改名Autopilot
items.summary: 微軟上周五宣布AI聊天助理Copilot將整合代理人工具Cowork、Office及程式開發功能，朝超級App更進一步，也允許企業在自管環境運行代理人runtime。長時在線（always-on）的代理人則改名Autopilot再出發。

items.title: Android Studio開放BYOA，Codex等代理可透過ACP串接IDE
items.summary: Google替Android Studio加入自帶代理（Bring Your Own Agent，BYOA）功能，開發者可將Anthropic Claude Agent、OpenAI Codex與Google Antigravity等程式開發代理串接Android Studio。BYOA採用代理用戶端協定（ACP），符合ACP規格的其他代理同樣可以串接，並使用Android Studio提供的專案資訊與開發工具。
